checked_obligation: Verify that each constructed Pell solution yields a positive integer n_k and that the displayed values of m are integer roots of equation (2).
reason: By n6, y_k is a positive odd integer, so n_k=(y_k+1)/2 is a positive integer. Equation (4) gives t_k^2=3y_k^2-2=12n_k^2-12n_k+1, exactly the discriminant of (2). This quantity is odd, so t_k is odd; hence 4n_k-1±t_k is even. The quadratic formula therefore gives the two integer roots m=(4n_k-1±t_k)/2 as stated. No cited external theorem is needed.
